# Mailzeon

> Mailzeon is an on-demand email account marketplace. Customers place an order specifying an email domain (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, ProtonMail, Zoho, and others) and a name preference (random or custom); independent verified workers accept the order, create the account, and deliver the credentials. Payment is held securely and only released to the worker once the order is confirmed delivered.

## What Mailzeon offers

- On-demand email account creation across many providers, not just Gmail
- Single-account or bulk orders (multiple accounts placed and paid for together, each created and delivered individually)
- Starts at a low minimum order amount, with a transparent flat platform commission
- A worker-side marketplace: verified workers browse open orders, accept them, and earn per account created
- Dispute and refund protection on every order
- Available both on the web and as a Telegram Mini App (@MailzeonBot)
- Referral programs for both customers and workers

## Key facts

- Website: https://mailzeon.shop
- Telegram: @MailzeonBot
- Supported email domains include: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, ProtonMail, Zoho, AOL, GMX, and more
- Base country / primary market: India
